run_webrtc_stt_server: run a WebRTC speech-to-text server using ActionEngine with a custom action registry and signalling URL
setup_action_engine_settings: configure ActionEngine global settings to auto-deserialize readers, read in order, and remove read chunks
create_webrtc_server: create a WebRTC server with a service, host, identity, signalling URL, and RTC config for real-time communication
configure_rtc_port_range: configure an RTC config object to set a preferred port range for WebRTC connections
create_actionengine_service: create an ActionEngine Service instance from an action registry to handle speech-to-text actions
